decision.reason: [ev-4b121944161e] is a single bug-fix line that points to PR #6663. It says only that a check for EbsOptimizedInfo was added when instances are selected by EBS maximum bandwidth. It does not name the requirement key, label or NodePool/NodeClass setting that triggers that selection path, so the open applicability aspect has nothing to build a condition from. It also does not state the symptom before the fix (a panic, a wrong selection or something else). The PR or code diff would be needed to say which environments are exposed.
